title: Create Strawberry GraphQL type definitions for DefineView
description:
Create `dashboard/backend/resolvers/define_types.py` with all Strawberry type classes for the Define page.

Types to define (matching tech spec API Surface exactly):
- `SpecIndicator`: exists (bool), path (Optional[str]), audit_status (str), warning_count (int), warnings (list[str])
- `SpecifiedData`: product_spec (SpecIndicator), technical_spec (SpecIndicator), design_spec (SpecIndicator), open_questions (int), sizing_estimate (Optional[int])
- `BuiltData`: coverage_pct (Optional[float]), criteria_passed (Optional[int]), criteria_total (Optional[int]), guardian_verdict (Optional[str]), task_progress (Optional[float]), tasks_done (Optional[int]), tasks_total (Optional[int]), blocked_count (int), completed_at (Optional[str])
- `GapEscalation`: description (str), linked_warning_id (Optional[str])
- `GapData`: escalation_count (int), escalations (list[GapEscalation]), unverifiable_count (int), rework_count (int)
- `DefineFeature`: name (str), state (str), specified (SpecifiedData), built (BuiltData), gap (GapData)
- `DefineDefect`: name (str), severity (str), status (str), description (str), impact (Optional[str]), filed_at (Optional[str])
- `DefineAggregates`: design_spec_count (int), feature_count (int), audit_warning_count (int), open_question_count (int), escalation_count (int), completed_count (int), executing_count (int), unplanned_count (int)
- `DefineView`: vision_status (str), vision_path (Optional[str]), features (list[DefineFeature]), defects (list[DefineDefect]), aggregates (DefineAggregates)

Follow the same pattern as `dashboard/backend/resolvers/landing_types.py` for type definition style.
acceptance_criteria:
- All 9 Strawberry types are defined with @strawberry.type decorator
- Field names use snake_case matching the tech spec
- Optional fields use Optional[] type hints
- List fields use list[] type hints
- File imports strawberry
- Types are importable from define_types
